title: Thai Style Flaky Omelette
description: A simple Thai style omelette with a flaky twist, made with eggs, flaky pastry and a kick of spice.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Place the flaky pastry in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs to the pan and cook until the eggs start to set.
Add the spicy to the eggs and mix well.
Use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in half.
Cook for a further 1-2 minutes, until the eggs are cooked through.
Serve the omelette hot, grilled to perfection.
